dedupe_keys.name: colorado river basin river and infrastructure connectivity network

description: RICON is a directed network linking streamgages, reservoirs and NHDPlus river features in the Colorado River Basin. The Figshare item lists an edge table, dam and gage attributes, terminal nodes and supporting spatial files. The Scientific Data descriptor reports a pilot network built from 1,344 dams and 1,656 streamgages in upper and lower basin areas. A modeller can use the topology to trace upstream dependencies, flow-alteration pathways or monitoring coverage in reservoir-operation simulations. It is a basin-specific constructed network, not a live hydraulic model or an observed discharge series. NHDPlus linkage and identifier assumptions should be checked before joining new assets. Figshare assigns MIT rights to the current data item. I read the own metadata and descriptor without downloading network files or running analyses. The companion RICON toolkit is reviewed separately; the old title screen did not inspect this reusable archive. A limitation is that missing or mismatched river identifiers can create false network edges and change inferred dependencies.
